description: Defines ASN.1 data structures and parsing classes, including Buffer, OID, Sequence, and related constants and enums, for ASN.1 encoding/decoding in the Thunder core namespace.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Manages a byte buffer with reference counting and size management, used for ASN.1 data handling.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: Represents an Object Identifier with parsing from string and byte array, including iteration over OID components.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: Represents an ASN.1 sequence, providing methods for parsing ASN.1 encoded data.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Elements()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over OID components.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the OID.

methods.name: Buffer()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the OID buffer.

methods.name: Text()
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the OID.

methods.name: Next()
methods.description: Advances to the next component in the OID.

methods.name: Value()
methods.description: Extracts various ASN.1 data types from a Sequence.
